items.title: Meta quietly launches vibe-coded gaming app Pocket
items.summary: Meta has quietly launched Pocket, an experimental AI app that lets users generate and share interactive mini games using text prompts.

items.title: Anthropic is discussing a new custom chip with Samsung
items.summary: The news comes about a week after OpenAI announced its own custom AI chip in a partnership with Broadcom.

items.title: OpenAI proposed donating 5% of its equity to a US sovereign wealth fund
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has reportedly proposed giving 5% of the company’s equity to a U.S. sovereign wealth fund, reviving discussions about letting the public share in the financial gains from the AI boom.

items.title: Microsoft launches its own AI deployment company with $2.5 billion commitment
items.summary: Microsoft follows Amazon, OpenAI, and Anthropic with its new AI deployment group.

items.title: Yep, we’re using OpenClaw to date now
items.summary: Ben Guez has "a bunch of potential international wives in [his] DMs," thanks to an automated script he set up using OpenClaw, Claude code, and Instagram trials.

items.title: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
items.summary: Neo is Bhavin Turakhia’s fifth venture and his latest involving enterprise software. This time he's taking on Microsoft Office and Google Apps with AI.

items.title: SpaceX has an AI device prototype, and it sure sounds phone-ish
items.summary: SpaceX reportedly showed investors a "handset-like" AI device before going public. It could be another signal SpaceX wants to expand into wireless.

items.title: Ashton Kutcher leaving Sound Ventures to launch new VC firm with Morgan Beller
items.summary: Sound built its reputation on concentrated, high-conviction bets in category-leading AI labs, while Kutcher's new fund appears to be chasing the layer underneath those companies — the infrastructure and energy that power them.

items.title: Cloudflare’s new policy pushes AI companies to pay for publishers’ content
items.summary: Cloudflare is giving AI companies until September 15 to separate web crawlers used for search from those used for AI training and agents, or risk being blocked by default on many publisher sites.

items.title: Venice AI becomes a unicorn with $65M Series A as its privacy-first AI platform takes off
items.summary: Venice AI is already profitable, with annualized run-rate revenues of over $70 million, CEO Erik Voorhees said.

items.title: Gemini Spark, Google’s agentic assistant, is now available on Mac
items.summary: Google's 24/7 agentic assistant, Gemini Spark, comes to Mac alongside other improvements, like real-time tracking and support for more apps.

items.title: Meta, like SpaceX, looks to turn excess AI compute into cash
items.summary: Meta is developing plans for a cloud infrastructure business, selling access to AI compute power and models. The move would pit it against the big cloud providers like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

items.title: Trump drops restrictions on Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable models
items.summary: The Trump administration's erratic approach to AI policymaking has left companies across the industry with little clarity about what will govern future model releases.

items.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
items.summary: Wayve’s offering is part of a growing trend of AI startups using employee tenders as a strategic tool to attract and retain talent.

items.title: OpenClaw is finally available on Android and iOS
items.summary: The free open source agentic program is finally invading your phone.

items.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
items.summary: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers, is now valued at more than $500 million.

items.title: New attack provides one more reason why AI browsers are a bad idea
items.summary: Telling an LLM that 2 + 2 = 5 is enough to make it follow forbidden instructions.

items.title: Google introduces a faster, cheaper image generator with Nano Banana 2 Lite
items.summary: Google is updating its image generator to make it faster and cheaper, making it a more useful tool for creators looking to make AI content.

items.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
items.summary: Nvidia AI chip competitor Etched says it has already booked $1 billion under contract for the inference systems powered by its chip.

items.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
items.summary: Notion is "going all in on using agents to run your inbox."

items.title: Oracle’s 21,000 layoffs help drive its debt-fueled AI investments
items.summary: Oracle is spending billions on data center infrastructure to support AI.
